scripts.build: npm run build:debug && npm run build:release
scripts.build:debug: cmake -E rm -rf dist/debug && emcmake cmake --fresh -G Ninja -B build -S . -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DPOB_WASM_PROFILING=${POB_WASM_PROFILING:-OFF} && EMCC_FORCE_STDLIBS=libc emmake ninja -C build
scripts.build:release: cmake -E rm -rf dist/release && emcmake cmake --fresh -G Ninja -B build -S . -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DPOB_WASM_PROFILING=${POB_WASM_PROFILING:-OFF} && EMCC_FORCE_STDLIBS=libc emmake ninja -C build
